name: game-fixture-types
goal: Typecheck every desktop browser and native fixture before runtime acceptance.

evidence: The 1f57 native capture failed in all six cases at imageProvider because appendFile was omitted during fixture extraction. Desktop tsconfig includes test but omits tests, so the normal typecheck did not inspect these runtime fixtures. Extend the existing normal typecheck include; keep source fixtures broken for a committed red proof.

The normal Svelte typecheck covered src and test but not tests/e2e. Add the whole browser/native fixture directory to its existing include list; do not exempt mocks or acceptance helpers. The strengthened normal check must name the missing import before repair.
